capabilities: Sync vault files to and from a SyncUp Notes server over WebDAV
Skip and report files that exceed the plan's file size limit
Stream large files from disk without loading them into memory
Share open note and expanded folder state with the SyncUp Notes web page
Run syncs on startup, after saves, and once per minute
extras: Mobile syncs only when Obsidian is open and stops after you leave the app; installation on desktop is by manually copying plugin files.
problem: Vault files only live on the device unless synced, and users of the SyncUp Notes web app need the same notes kept up to date in both places.

relations.evidence: Install BRAT from Community plugins. Run Plugins: Add a beta plugin for testing

requires.name: SyncUp Notes account with application password
SyncUp plan with a file size limit

summary: Two-way sync plugin that keeps an Obsidian vault in sync with a SyncUp Notes account over WebDAV on desktop and mobile.
